data_source: real daily OHLCV for GLD, IWM, QQQ, SPY, TLT via Yahoo Finance (yfinance), 2010-01-04 to 2023-12-29 (3522 trading days); cached in data/market_data.pkl
note: Deep-RL portfolio agents (DQN, SAC) trained and evaluated on real market data. Both underperform a buy-and-hold baseline over this period (negative Sharpe); the figures are reported as measured, not tuned to look favourable.
